STUDY 138
Plum Ribbed Knit & Lilac Suede Mini
Rights check
Source: 25033.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight light brown
hair walks down a bright hallway with a glossy floor.
She wears a fitted plum ribbed knit top with a deep V
neckline, layered with a pendant necklace and a pearl
choker. A lilac suede mini skirt has a gold medallion
belt, and she carries a silver chainmail-style shoulder
bag. Tall black knee boots complete the look. Her
expression is calm and composed. Soft indoor light.
Palette of plum, lilac, and silver. Cozy and nostalgic, in
the style of a 2000s film still.
Cozy, nostalgic, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The plum knit and lilac suede mini are the color pairing.
- Keep the hallway for a candid, walking motion.
